description: This file defines the TaskRepository class, which provides an interface to manage tasks stored locally via LocalTaskStore. It includes methods for observing, adding, updating, deleting, and toggling tasks, facilitating reactive data flows in an Android application.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: A repository class providing task management functions backed by LocalTaskStore, encapsulating data operations and exposing reactive flows.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate TaskRepository with a LocalTaskStore.

methods.name: observeTasks
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the list of all tasks, sorted by completion status and recency.

methods.name: observeTask
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a single task matching the given id.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task with the provided title and description, returning the new task's id.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by id with new title, description, and completion status.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes the task identified by the given id.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Sets the completion state of the task with the specified id.
